instructions: Assign the 27 concept slots to the 27 blueprint slots (any order, but a DI set of 3 should share a concept area). Each question: one primary concept (the slot) and optional secondary tags. Provide a python verification script. typeFocus ranks question types by practice need (miss rate plus slowness against pace): put the weakest review words / skills / concepts on the slots of the top two types (need >= 0.4), so the practice lands where it is needed.
